name: @treaty-examples/ng-bench-app
description: Standard, pure-Angular full application used as a fair apples-to-apples compile benchmark fixture: it builds with BOTH the Angular CLI (`ng build` / @angular/build:application) AND Treaty's bundler plugins, because it uses ZERO Treaty-only features (no .treaty SFCs, no JSX/.tsx, no React, no macros, no server{} blocks) -- only standard Angular .ts the Angular compiler accepts.
